name: Carter Fund Grants

funder.name: Native Plant Society of New Mexico (Jack and Martha Carter Conservation Fund)

summary: Small grants for native plant restoration, conservation, research and education projects, covering supplies, tools, seeds, equipment rental and contractors. Members and non-members can apply.

amount.note: At most two grants at this size

reporting: Written year-end summary report due by November 1.

calls.label: Grants for 2027
calls.recurring: Applications are due November 30 of the year before funding is awarded.

status.quote: If you are interested in applying this year (2026) for funding in 2027, continue below to learn how it works.

recurring.quote: Applications for grants and donations are due by November 30th of the year before funding is awarded.

applicant_types.quote: supports organizations, communities, students, and individuals working on projects that further education, restoration, research, and conservation of native plants.

window.quote: Applications for grants and donations are due by November 30th of the year before funding is awarded.

amount.quote: Two grants of up to $5000 each may be awarded to projects with a significant and lasting impact.

reporting.quote: Successful grant winners are required to submit a written, year-end summary report (a template will be provided) due by November 1.
